_comment: Copy of h1/isaac_reference.json for the Unity port. Two changes only: (1) 'root_quat_w_wxyz' renamed to 'root_quat_w_xyzw' - rig_audit.py section D proves the stored order is XYZW (projected-gravity residual 3.3e-05 as xyzw vs 1.73 as wxyz); (2) joint_vel verified against obs[31:50] to 0.000e+00, so it is the recorded value, not a finite-difference reconstruction. Values are otherwise byte-identical.
